text: Retrieval-augmented generation combines a pre-trained parametric language model with a non-parametric memory, a dense vector index of Wikipedia, so that generation is conditioned on retrieved passages.
The Transformer is a sequence transduction architecture based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.
BERT pre-trains deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by conditioning on both left and right context in all layers.
LoRA freezes the pre-trained model weights and injects trainable low-rank decomposition matrices into each layer, greatly reducing the number of trainable parameters.
Chain-of-thought prompting shows that giving a few examples with intermediate reasoning steps improves the reasoning ability of large language models.
